SecurityHeaders._comment: CSP ships Report-Only so violations can be collected without breaking the public layout's inline scripts. Once a report comes back clean, move the value to ContentSecurityPolicy to enforce it.
SecurityHeaders.ContentSecurityPolicyReportOnly: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://unpkg.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' wss: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
